description_zh: 查询DDoS高防实例的详情列表
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo describe-instances --resource-group-id rg-acfm2pz25js0000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --ip 203.107.XX.XX --remark doc-test --edition 9 --enabled 1 --expire-start-time 1640361500000 --expire-end-time 1640361700000 --instance-ids ddoscoo-cn-7pp2g9ed0000 --status 1 --tag Value=test-value Key=test-key --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not specify this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS高防实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。

不设置该参数表示默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置当前页面的页码
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，设置每页包含实例的数量。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The IP address of the instance to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的IP地址
parameters.name: ip

parameters.help_en: The remarks of the instance to query. Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的备注。支持模糊查询
parameters.name: remark

parameters.help_en:
The mitigation plan of the instance to query. Valid values:

0: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Insurance mitigation plan
1: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Unlimited mitigation plan
2: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Outside Chinese Mainland) instance of the Chinese Mainland Acceleration (CMA) mitigation plan
9: Anti-DDoS Proxy (Chinese Mainland) instance of the Profession mitigation plan
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的防护套餐版本。取值：

0：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）保险版。
1：表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）无忧版。
2： 表示DDoS高防（非中国内地）加速线路。
9：表示DDoS高防（中国内地）专业版
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en:
The traffic forwarding status of the instance to query. Valid values:

0: The instance no longer forwards service traffic.
1: The instance forwards service traffic as expected
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例的业务流量转发状态。取值：

0：表示已停止转发业务流量。
1：表示正常转发业务流量
parameters.name: enabled

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Instances whose expiration time is later than the point in time are queried. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的最早到期时间（即查询到期时间在ExpireStartTime之后的DDoS高防实例）。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: expire_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Instances whose expiration time is earlier than the point in time are queried. This value is a UNIX timestamp. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的最晚到期时间（即查询到期时间在ExpireEndTime之前的DDoS高防实例）。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒
parameters.name: expire_end_time

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the instances to query. You can specify up to 200 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的ID列表。最多可配置200个DDoS高防实例
parameters.name: instance_ids

parameters.help_en: The states of the instances to query. You can specify up to two states
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的DDoS高防实例的状态列表。最多可配置2个DDoS高防实例状态
parameters.name: status

fields.help_en:
The key of the tag that is added to the instance to query. You can specify up to 200 tag keys. When you specify tags, take note of the following rules:

Each tag consists of a key (Key) and a value (Value), which are separated with a comma (,).
Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

The tag key (Key) and tag value (Value) must be specified in pairs
fields.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签键。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个标签键。配置规则如下：

每个标签包含一个标签键（Key）和一个标签值（Value），中间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
标签之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

标签键（Key）和标签值（Value）必须成对出现
fields.name: key

fields.help_en:
The value of the tag that is added to the instance to query. You can specify up to 200 tag values. When you specify tags, take note of the following rules:

Each tag consists of a key (Key) and a value (Value), which are separated with a comma (,).
Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

The tag key (Key) and tag value (Value) must be specified in pairs
fields.help_zh:
要查询的DDoS高防实例绑定的标签值。N的最大值：200，即最多可配置200个标签值。配置规则如下：

每个标签包含一个标签键（Key）和一个标签值（Value），中间用半角逗号（,）隔开。
标签之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

标签键（Key）和标签值（Value）必须成对出现
fields.name: value
